calls.reason: Mixed: the $6.4B all-equity io deal supports the stock-acquisition part, but Anthropic's own $50B data-center commitment undercuts 'fully paid for by other companies', and xAI scale data is only partial context.
Cherny cited about 8B tokens since March but gave no token mix or model, so it can't be priced. The only dollar estimate is an unsourced blog figure of roughly $75k a month.
Rhetorical 'nobody' and an unobservable market-psychology mechanism. The Batch confirms the selloff, and the Klarna and Cursor cases are partial, but nothing tests the claim.
No filing, restatement or reporting shows OpenAI reclassified costs to flatter results. Epoch's guess that free-user inference sits in S&M is analyst inference, and the S&M part is hedged.
